scope: Controlled SDK responses and real private checkpoint dry admission; no new provider inference or model accuracy.
checks: Only missing input reaches the provider stub
Wrong saved answers are not corrected or retried
Complete independent replay matches saved aggregate results
Model identity and call caps cannot change
Missing capacity refuses a new reservation without resetting old records
Changed original evidence stops the cohort, not just one answer
Partial provider failure produces no complete-cohort score
Export binds both original and new reservations and copied observations
limits: These are fictional controlled checks and a read-only plan on existing private evidence. The new complete live cohort is not yet executed. Saved historical responses remain unauthenticated; local checksums and token-cost estimates are not provider attestations or invoices.
